unit.title: The sleeve makes or breaks it
unit.needIt: A jacket that pulls at the shoulder or twists at the arm is a sleeve problem. Knowing that tells you what to check before you buy or sew.
unit.why: A dressmaker once saw a beautiful gown ruined by a poorly fitting sleeve. She learned that the sleeve is the most important part of a garment's look. You must plan the sleeve to match the unique shape of your own arm.
unit.outcome: Select and adjust a sleeve pattern to fit your specific arm shape.
unit.reachesYou: You see this when you try on a shirt at a shop and the arm feels tight. You also notice it when a friend's sleeve twists around their wrist.
unit.do: Measure your arm from shoulder to wrist and notice if your arm is thick or slender.

quiz.q: How should a short, thick arm be treated in a sleeve design?
quiz.why: The text says short thick arms need long unbroken lines to add length.
quiz.quote: the short, thick arm should have long unbroken lines predominating in the sleeve

quiz.q: What should be avoided for a short fleshy arm?
quiz.why: The text says these arms should never be divided up with straight round cuffs.
quiz.quote: This arm should never be divided up with straight round cuffs.

quiz.q: How should long, slender arms be designed?
choices: With lines broken here and there
quiz.why: The text explains that long arms look better when the lines are broken.
quiz.quote: made to look well proportioned by choosing a sleeve with length lines broken here and there.

choices: The inside seam twists to the top of the arm
quiz.why: The text defines twisting as the inside seam moving to the top of the arm at the wrist.
quiz.quote: By "sleeve twisting" we mean when the inside seam of the sleeve will twist around to the top of the arm at the wrist.

quiz.q: How can you tell if a sleeve will twist from a pattern?
choices: If the pattern is too small
If the inside seam is even at the wrist
If the pattern is too wide
If the pattern is too long
quiz.why: The text says if the inside seam meets all the way and is even at the wrist, it may twist.
quiz.quote: the inside seam meets all the way and is even at the wrist, the sleeve may twist

partials: Sleeves are very important for a garment's beauty.
A poorly made sleeve ruins a style.
You must plan the sleeve to fit your arm shape.
Short arms need long lines to add length.
Long arms need broken lines to look balanced.
crystal.key: The sleeve must be planned to match the specific shape and size of the wearer's arm.

decoys.text: Any sleeve pattern will fit any person perfectly.
decoys.why: The text says we cannot always wear the sleeve designed for the gown we have selected.

decoys.text: Straight round cuffs are best for short arms.
decoys.why: The text says a short fleshy arm should never be divided up with straight round cuffs.

crystal.aha: By matching the sleeve lines to your arm's unique shape, you ensure the garment looks beautiful and fits well.

actors.label: One part off, and all of it is off.

beats.say: Plan the sleeve to the shape of your own arm.
